name: exists_common_coset_reps
summary: Choose representatives adjusted by GL_b(O) so that inverse transposes stay representatives (Smith normal form), and extend the finite-sum functional from finitely supported functions to all functions.

steps.claim: For each coset q choose k(q) ∈ GL_b(O) with (q̄⁻¹)^{−T} = k^{−T}·q̄·k for the chosen element q̄ of q (`exists_invTransposeGL_inv_eq`, from the Smith normal form of the valuation pair; Skolem) and put r_q = q̄·k(q); extend the functional "sum of the values", defined on finitely supported functions, to a linear functional ℓ on all functions (a linear map out of a subspace extends). Property (1) is the extension property for the finitely supported function that agrees with f on t (`Finsupp.onFinset`). Property (2): a left-invertible y has some u ∈ GL_b(F) with y·u primitive (`IsValuationPair.exists_isPrimitiveMatrix_mul`); two such differ by an element of GL_b(O) (`IsPrimitiveMatrix.mul_iff`, `isPrimitiveMatrix_iff_mem_intGL`), so exactly one coset works; the same for r_q⁻¹, inverse transposes of elements of GL_b(O) lying in GL_b(O) (`invTransposeGL_mem_intGL`).
steps.lean:
IsPrimitiveMatrix O (y * (r q).1)) ∧ ∃! q, IsPrimitiveMatrix O (y * (r q).1⁻¹) := match skolem.1
  (exists_invTransposeGL_inv_eq valPair ·.out),
  lcoeFun.dualMap_surjective_of_injective DFunLike.coe_injective (lsum ℂ 1)
  with | ⟨k, _⟩, ⟨ℓ, L⟩ => ⟨ℓ ∘ₗ .funLeft .., (·.out) * k, fun t f h ↦ congr($L (onFinset t _
  h)).trans (by simp), fun y h ↦ (valPair.exists_isPrimitiveMatrix_mul h).elim fun u p ↦ by
  have := (p.2.mul_iff.trans <| isPrimitiveMatrix_iff_mem_intGL <| u⁻¹ * ·)
  simp_all [← coe_units_inv, -Pi.mul_apply]
  simp_all [↓← invTransposeGL_mem_intGL (_ * _⁻¹), ← QuotientGroup.eq, mul_assoc]⟩
